title: Spicy Fry Surprise
description: A flavorful and spicy dish made with a combination of mixed ingredients. Serve hot and enjoy!

ingredients.name: Surprise ingredient (optional)
ingredients.notes: Add a twist to the dish

instructions: Heat the fry oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and fry until they are tender.
Sprinkle the fry spice blend over the vegetables and stir well.
If using a surprise ingredient, add it to the pan and stir well.
